title: Dynamic Identity
subtitle: Composite keys and factory params
description: Drive recreate + persist identity from route params without losing bound-hook DX.

callouts.title: One active key
callouts.content: createResourceHooks still shares one module instance. Switching params recreates it. Parallel editors need pass-resource or useCollection.

content: Resource keys can be tuples. Factory hooks take one params argument (object or tuple) that builds key + closures.

sections.title: useResource(config) recreate
sections.content: Plain `useResource` recreates when `serialize(config.key)` changes. Other config is captured at create time — put fetch closures that close over the latest id inside the config used for that key.

sections.title: Multiple args?
sections.content: Pass one object or tuple to `useResource(params)` — not `useResource(a, b)`. Put a composite `key` array in the returned config.
